top_signals.title: UAE Probe Labels FlyDubai Cockpit Ax Attack a Terrorist Act
top_signals.summary: A United Arab Emirates investigation of the near-catastrophic FlyDubai flight said the co-pilot attempted “to carry out a terrorist act” as more details emerged about what happened in the cockpit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
